item.description: ConnectWise on Saturday said it has disabled seven ConnectWise application identities as it continues its investigation into an incident in which unknown threat actors obtained unauthorized access to the application identities and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants. item.description: Microsoft today issued updates to fix more than 1,400 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and other software. item.description: Updated the Security Updates table to list Microsoft Identity Web v3 and v4 separately and clarify the affected version ranges. The existing security updates are versions 3.16.0 and 4.16.1, respectively. This is an informational change only.

item.title: OpenCode hack exposes API keys amid AI distillation attacks
item.description: The open-source AI coding project OpenCode has notified a small number of users that API keys they used with external providers were exposed in a security breach.

item.title: CVE-2026-70197 .NET Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: Microsoft is aware that the vulnerability for which this CVE was assigned has not been addressed. We are working to prepare and test a complete mitigation. We will update this document when there is more information.

item.title: Microsoft fixes classic Outlook bug that hid Copilot buttons
item.description: Microsoft has fixed a known issue that removed the Copilot Chat and Copilot buttons in the classic Outlook desktop mail client for some Windows users.

item.description: A suspected advanced threat actor has been observed exploiting a security flaw in Fortinet FortiOS to deliver a previously unreported memory-resident ARM64 malware known as PEERSTITCH. item.description: Palo Alto Networks on Wednesday issued security updates for a high-severity flaw in PAN-OS software that has come under active exploitation. item.title: AhsayCBS Flaws Exploited to Deploy Web Shells Get New Fixes After Incomplete Patches
item.description: Singapore-based Ahsay Backup has released security updates to address two security flaws in AhsayCBS that have been exploited by bad actors to drop web shells and XMRig cryptocurrency miners. item.title: Nikkei discloses third data breach in a month, 1.8M records exposed
item.description: Nikkei Inc. disclosed a new data breach, the third in about a month, that exposed 1.83 million personal information records.

item.title: Microsoft fixes game, app crashes caused by recent Windows update
item.description: Microsoft has resolved a bug that caused games and apps using AC-3 (Dolby Digital) audio decoding to crash after installing the September 2026 Windows 11 preview update (KB5124010).

item.title: F5 releases out-of-band patches for critical NGINX vulnerabilities
item.description: F5 has released out-of-band security patches to address multiple NGINX web server flaws, including three critical-severity vulnerabilities that can let attackers execute code on vulnerable systems.

item.title: Feds Suspect Ransom Negotiator Ran ShinyHunters Extortion Site
item.description: U.S. federal investigators pursuing the ShinyHunters hacking group that recently stole highly sensitive data from the FBI have identified executives at two different ransomware negotiation firms who maintained unusually close relations with the extortion group, KrebsOnSecurity has learned. item.title: Microsoft: October Windows Server updates break Exchange sign-in, mail flow
item.description: Microsoft has confirmed that this month's Windows Server security updates are causing OWA sign-in and mail delivery issues on some Exchange Server systems.

item.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
item.description: An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said. Console is OpenCode's optional hosted service: a workspace saves its own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google key there, and Console uses…

item.title: Inside the Underground Market for Know Your Client Services
item.description: Cybercriminals are selling forged identity documents, deepfake videos, and live verification services to help buyers bypass Know Your Client (KYC) checks. Flare examines how these underground services operate and the techniques used to create and maintain fraudulent verified accounts.

item.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
item.description: OpenAI said internal models hacked two more websites, bypassed company-imposed browsing restrictions, and used exposed credentials to draw cryptocurrency from a wallet it couldn’t otherwise access, in the latest installment of disclosures of the unethical and likely illegal acts its agents are performing. item.description: This CVE was assigned by Chrome. Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) ingests Chromium, which addresses this vulnerability. Please see [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026) for more information.

item.description: Updated an acknowledgement. This is an informational change only.

item.title: Hackers exploit Collabora RCE flaw to backdoor Nextcloud servers
item.description: Threat actors are exploiting a critical command execution flaw, now tracked as CVE-2026-110447, in the Collabora Online - Built-in CODE Server app (richdocumentscode) for Nextcloud.

item.title: Critical PwnEscape Linux Kernel Vulnerability Lets Guest VMs Read Host Memory
item.description: A newly disclosed critical flaw in the Linux kernel allows code inside a virtual machine to read memory on the host computer it runs on. item.title: Langflow's Critical Authenticated RCE Flaw Targeted in 1,423 Honeypot Exploit Attempts
item.description: Threat actors are exploiting a critical security flaw in Langflow, according to an alert from Previdian. Langflow is an open-source platform that allows developers to build artificial intelligence (AI) applications and agentic workflows. item.description: Attackers exploited a flaw in an optional Nextcloud app, Collabora Online - Built-in CODE Server, to plant web shells on Nextcloud servers. item.title: WordPress SEO plugin Rank Math compromised to backdoor websites
item.description: Some downloads of the Rank Math PRO WordPress plugin from the vendor's official website carried malware that planted hidden backdoors in a supply-chain attack last week.

item.title: Bullhorn takes staffing platform offline to contain cyberattack
item.description: Staffing software company Bullhorn has disabled access to its platform to contain a cyberattack that caused a system-wide outage.

item.title: Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers
item.description: A flaw in Broadcom's Wi-Fi setup software lets an attacker within radio range run code as root on Broadcom-based routers, without the network password or any pairing step, security researcher Quentin Kaiser disclosed on October 16. item.title: Drupal patches critical RCE flaws, warns exploits may emerge soon
item.description: Drupal has patched two critical vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to execute code remotely on websites running any supported version of the content management system.
